environment.cameraProtocol: Fullscreen responsive interface; Scriptable camera held at (14,9,24), lookAt (0,2,0), vertical FOV 60. No world-camera quality claim.

protocol.camera: Fullscreen responsive interface; Scriptable camera held at (14,9,24), lookAt (0,2,0), vertical FOV 60. Holding the camera prevents hidden default follow-camera motion during acquisition.
protocol.player: Single Studio Play client. Use the actual Gain XP button twice after reset. The loop is client-local; no multiplayer or server-XP claim.
protocol.lighting: ClockTime 14, Brightness 2, Ambient and OutdoorAmbient RGB(110,110,110), GlobalShadows false. The fullscreen product UI covers the scene and is identical in behavior across variants.
protocol.graphics: On the validated macOS Studio 0.739 setup, use Rendering > Graphics Mode OpenGL and restart Studio: Metal returned solid-magenta Play screenshots. Set EditQualityLevel to Level21 and require the Play client's QualityLevel to report Level21. This Studio build resets QualityLevel when Play starts; an Edit Command Bar assignment does not establish Play quality. Check the Client render.settings event in the trial trace; unavailable settings or deviations leave capture review incomplete. Keep the same renderer and quality across the corpus. Preserve original acquired bytes.
protocol.action: The fixed gui_button plan collects three ordered states. BasaltEvalCaptureControls occupies only the top 9% of the native viewport. Mask that strip for judging after human verification; preserve all product UI. No resizing or required resolution. Use Run capture from the connected Edit plugin; do not click controls manually during a trial.
protocol.limitations: Four reserved validation presentations in two new layout families. Same mechanic, camera, input sequence and previously human-approved rubric as development; no new mechanic or timing claim. Ordered stills cannot establish response latency. No model outputs or expert labels exist for this population. Keep all cases, including borderline and insufficient evidence; capture failures remain incomplete. Freeze exact clean evidence and independent expert labels before judge output. Do not tune on these candidates. See docs/VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md.
